facts.fact: The Consumer Federation of Kenya (COFEK), a civil-society group, challenged in the High Court the award of the Digital Superhighway tenders to Nightigale (EA) Limited over alleged conflict of interest, and on 2026-09-04 won an order quashing the Attorney-General's advisory opinion of 1 October 2024 clearing the procurement; it lost its bid to void the contracts.
facts.system: Attorney-General's advisory opinion on the Digital Superhighway tender
